title: 第15章 劫后余生第16章 赤火佣兵团的至宝
lines: 看着那刺眼的光芒，所有人都停下了脚步！萧羽等人也是被这样的场景惊呆了！
生平第一次见到尊者，竟然是以这种方式结束！这位老人是值得萧羽尊敬的，如果不是为了保护这些年轻的后辈，萧羽相信，赤振峰是一定可以脱险的！但是他却没有选择独善其身。
所有的赤火佣兵团的人，都是面向后方，跪了下来，重重的磕了三个头！萧羽等人也是面向老人战斗过的方向深深的鞠了一躬。
看着跪在地上不肯起身的众人，萧羽大声道：“我想你们应该知道他是为谁而死！就是因为你们这些没用的废物！”
萧羽这句话一出口，所有人都愣了，甚至蛮儿和弓紫嫣还有黑子都跟看白痴一样看着萧羽，气氛一下子紧张了起来。
弓紫嫣和蛮儿已经将武器拿在了手。
一个衣衫破烂的男子，突然冲过来一把揪住萧羽的衣领，血红的眼睛瞪着萧羽，从牙齿缝里挤出了几句话：“你说什么？你有种再说一遍？！”
“放开他！”
“放开主人！”
弓紫嫣拉满弓箭指男子，蛮儿拎出了战锤，就要冲过来。
萧羽挥了挥手制止了蛮儿。
看着眼前的男子，不屑的道：“我说你们这些人都是废物！他为什么会死！因为他希望你们可以更好的活着！用他自己的一条命可以换你们所有人的命！他等着你们会给他报仇！可是你们呢？看看你们的样子，跪在地上不起来，一群懦夫！没骨气！”
“我们不是懦夫！我们愿回去与敌人死战！”赤火用团的人怒吼道。
“回去干什么？回去送死是吗？你们该不会天真的以为，那两个尊者境已经死了吧？
就你们这些灵武境所有人加上都不够人家挥手灭的？如果你们不想辜负你们死去的团长，那就站起来跟我逃命！
如果想死，我不会拦着你们，还有把你们身上那该死的，衣服扯掉，是想告诉大周的人，你们是从哪里来的吗？!"
“跟我逃，拿出你们吃奶的力气逃啊！~”
萧羽背起黑子转身就跑。
弓紫嫣看着前面的男人，突然感觉自己应该重新审视一下这个男子了。
听着后面传来的脚步声，萧羽的嘴角露出了笑容，因为戴着白色骷髅面具的原因，这笑容看起来有些邪恶！
很快他们已经看到了青山镇的建筑和落日山脉附近的城墙。
与此同时，在刚才爆炸的位置，两个身影缓缓升起！正是洛武阳和赵克金两人！
两人早已没有了之前的从容，反而看起来特别的狼狈。赵克金的伤势要比洛阳更重一些，身体多处被洞穿，一只手臂也不知道，被炸到哪里去了！
因为在赤振峰自爆的瞬间，赵克金用自己的身体护住了，洛武阳！作为一名军人他十分清楚自己的责任在哪里。
“克金，你就在此地恢复，我去去就来，还有哪个带面具的小子，也有些诡异，似乎身上有可以隔绝灵识的至宝，我一定要将他们斩草除根！不然会为我天阳帝国留下祸患！”洛武阳凶狠的道。
content_en:
Looking at the dazzling light, everyone stopped! Xiao Yu and others were also shocked by such a scene!
The first time I met His Holiness ended up in this way! This old man is worthy of Xiao Yu's respect. If it weren't for protecting these young descendants, Xiao Yu believes that Chi Zhenfeng will definitely be able to escape! But he did not choose to be alone.
All the members of the Red Fire Mercenary Group faced back, knelt down, and kowtowed three times! Xiao Yu and others also bowed deeply in the direction where the old man had fought.
Looking at the people who were kneeling on the ground and refused to get up, Xiao Yu said loudly: "I think you should know who he died for! It's because of you useless trash!"
As soon as Xiao Yu said these words, everyone was stunned. Even Man'er, Gong Ziyan and Heizi looked at Xiao Yu as if they were idiots, and the atmosphere suddenly became tense.
Gong Ziyan and Man'er already had weapons in their hands.
A man in tattered clothes suddenly rushed over and grabbed Xiao Yu's collar. He stared at Xiao Yu with blood-red eyes and squeezed out a few words through his teeth: "What did you say? Do you have the guts to say it again?!"
"Let him go!"
"Let go Master!"
Ziyan drew her bow and arrows and pointed at the man. Man'er took out his war hammer and was about to charge over.
Xiao Yu waved his hand to stop Man'er.
Looking at the man in front of him, he said disdainfully: "I said you people are all trash! Why did he die! Because he wanted you to live a better life! He could exchange all of your lives with his own life! He was waiting for you to avenge him! But what about you? Look at you, you are kneeling on the ground and can't get up, a bunch of cowards! You have no spine!"
"We are not cowards! We are willing to go back and fight the enemy to the death!" the members of the Chihuo regiment roared angrily.
"What are you going back for? Are you going back to die? Don't you naively think that those two Venerable Realms are already dead?
Just all of you in the Lingwu Realm are not enough to be wiped out with a wave of your hand? If you don't want to let down your dead leader, then stand up and run away with me!
If you want to die, I won't stop you, and I will tear off your damn clothes. Do you want to tell people in Dazhou where you come from? !"
"Flee with me, use all your strength to escape!~"
Xiao Yu picked up Heizi and ran away.
Gong Ziyan looked at the man in front of her, and suddenly felt that she should take another look at this man.
Listening to the footsteps coming from behind, Xiao Yu's mouth showed a smile. Because he was wearing a white skull mask, this smile looked a little evil!
Soon they had seen the buildings of Qingshan Town and the city walls near the Sunset Mountains.
At the same time, two figures slowly rose from the location of the explosion! It was Luo Wuyang and Zhao Kejin!
The two of them no longer had the calmness they had before, but looked particularly embarrassed. Zhao Kejin's injuries were more serious than those in Luoyang. His body was pierced in many places, and one of his arms was blown to nowhere!
Because at the moment when Chi Zhenfeng blew himself up, Zhao Kejin used his body to protect Luo Wuyang! As a soldier, he knows exactly where his responsibilities lie.
"Kejin, you can recover here. I'll come back as soon as I go. There is also a kid with a mask who is a little weird. It seems that he has a treasure that can isolate spiritual consciousness. I must eradicate them! Otherwise, they will leave trouble for our Tianyang Empire!" Luo Wuyang said fiercely.
title_en: Chapter 15 The Remaining Life Chapter 16 The Treasure of the Red Fire Mercenary Group
